summary: In accordance with Chapter 27, Council Procedures, of the Toronto Municipal Code, Mayor John Tory will submit to City Council his recommendation on the membership of the Striking Committee. The Striking Committee will meet on December 12, 2018 to consider Member appointments and a Schedule of Meetings for 2019. City Council will consider the Striking Committee's Report when Council reconvenes on December 13, 2018.
decided: City Council on December 5, 2018 adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following Members of Council to the Striking Committee for a term of office ending December 31, 2020 or until their successors are appointed: Councillor Frances Nunziata Councillor Gary Crawford Councillor Jaye Robinson Councillor Stephen Holyday

text: In accordance with Chapter 27, Council Procedures, of the Toronto Municipal Code, Mayor John Tory will submit to City Council his recommendation on the membership of the Striking Committee. The Striking Committee will meet on December 12, 2018 to consider Member appointments and a Schedule of Meetings for 2019. City Council will consider the Striking Committee's Report when Council reconvenes on December 13, 2018.

City Council on December 5, 2018 adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following Members of Council to the Striking Committee for a term of office ending December 31, 2020 or until their successors are appointed: Councillor Frances Nunziata Councillor Gary Crawford Councillor Jaye Robinson Councillor Stephen Holyday
